summary: This document registers status codes that let a mail server tell a sender that a message was rejected or deferred because of email authentication failures. It updates RFC 7208, since some registered codes replace those it recommended.

eli5.summary: When a post office refuses a letter, it helps to say why. This RFC gives mail servers standard codes to say a message failed checks that prove who sent it.
